decks.notes: This deck focuses on quickly casting spells to trigger Arclight Phoenix's ability and bring it back from the graveyard to attack the opponent. It includes a mix of cheap spells, card draw, and burn spells to control the board and deal damage, while also utilizing cards like Treasure Cruise to refill the hand. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays and utilize the Phoenix's ability to keep attacking turn after turn. The deck also includes some spell recursion and counter spells to protect its game plan.

This deck focuses on assembling the Greasefang Parhelion combo, using cards like Greasefang, Okiba Boss and Parhelion II. The goal is to generate value and create a powerful board state by utilizing cards like Bloodtithe Harvester and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker. Removal spells like Fatal Push and Vanishing Verse help to control the board while Thoughtseize disrupts the opponent's strategy. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Skysovereign, Consul Flagship to seal the deal. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of combo pieces and aggressive creatures.

The deck is focused on fast-paced aggression, aiming to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of low-cost creatures and burn spells. It utilizes cards like Monastery Swiftspear, Emberheart Challenger, and Cunning Coyote to deal damage quickly, while spells like Play with Fire and Monstrous Rage provide additional reach and removal. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the aggressive strategy, with lands like Karplusan Forest and Copperline Gorge enabling consistent and efficient plays. Overall, the deck seeks to establish early dominance and maintain pressure throughout the game.

The deck focuses on controlling the board through removal spells like Fatal Push and Vanishing Verse, while utilizing Leyline Binding to lock down opposing threats. Zur, Eternal Schemer serves as the centerpiece of the deck, providing card advantage and searching for key enchantments. The mana base includes a variety of dual lands to ensure consistency in casting spells of different colors. The Overlord creatures offer additional control options and can help close out the game once the opponent's resources have been depleted. The deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents in a longer game.

This deck focuses on sacrificing creatures and using their abilities for maximum damage output, while also utilizing the "Companion" mechanic to provide additional value. By combining cards like Mayhem Devil, Cauldron Familiar, and Witch's Oven, the deck can deal damage to both creatures and opponents consistently. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a Companion allows for additional ramp and flexibility in mana usage. With a mix of removal spells, sacrifice outlets, and aggressive creatures, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents quickly and efficiently.

The main focus of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to build a fast and aggressive board presence utilizing low-cost creatures like Callous Sell-Sword, Emberheart Challenger, and Monastery Swiftspear. The deck also includes burn spells like Infuriate and Monstrous Rage to push through damage quickly. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion allows for additional ramp and versatility. The mana base composed of lands like Blackcleave Cliffs and Sulfurous Springs ensures consistent access to the colors needed for the aggressive game plan.

The deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures and burn spells to quickly deal damage to the opponent. It includes creatures with haste and prowess abilities to increase damage output, along with burn spells like Titan's Strength and Reckless Rage to remove opposing threats. The inclusion of Jegantha as a companion allows for additional consistency in mana production. Overall, the deck aims to apply pressure early in the game and maintain tempo to overwhelm the opponent with a fast-paced, aggressive strategy.

The main idea of this Selesnya Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy. The deck aims to quickly develop a board presence with efficient creatures like Aven Interrupter and Skyclave Apparition, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Elite Spellbinder and Thalia, Guardian of Thraben. By utilizing cards like Collected Company to put multiple threats on the battlefield at once, the deck seeks to apply pressure and close out the game before the opponent can stabilize.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on maintaining a fast and aggressive pace through a combination of low-cost creatures and burn spells. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents quickly with creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Kumano Faces Kakkazan, while also using spells like Monstrous Rage and Infuriate to deal additional damage. The inclusion of the companion Jegantha, the Wellspring adds an additional element to the deck, allowing for more flexibility with mana costs. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to apply relentless pressure and push for early wins.

The deck focuses on utilizing Lotus Field alongside cards that untap lands or generate additional mana to create large amounts of mana quickly, allowing for explosive plays and combos. It also includes cards for card draw and manipulation to help find key pieces of the combo. The deck aims to assemble its combo pieces quickly and efficiently to overwhelm the opponent with a powerful board state or game-winning play.

The deck focuses on playing fast and aggressive creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Soul-Scar Mage, while utilizing burn spells like Skewer the Critics and Wizard's Lightning to quickly chip away at the opponent's life total. Cards like Ramunap Ruins and Den of the Bugbear provide extra reach and damage, while Monstrous Rage and Light Up the Stage help maintain card advantage and ensure a steady stream of threats. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with early pressure and efficient removal spells to secure a quick victory.

The primary focus of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to overwhelm opponents with fast and aggressive creatures while utilizing burn spells and combat tricks to maintain pressure and control the board. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional value and versatility. With a blend of efficient creatures, direct damage spells, and aggressive lands, this deck aims to quickly deplete opponents' life totals and secure victories through a relentless offensive strategy.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on fast-paced aggression and utilizing low-cost creatures to deal quick damage to the opponent. The key concept revolves around creating a strong board presence early on with cards like Monastery Swiftspear and Heartfire Hero, while also having removal spells like Fatal Push to handle the opponent's threats. Den of the Bugbear and Ramunap Ruins provide additional damage sources, allowing the deck to close out games quickly before the opponent can stabilize. Jegantha, the Wellspring serves as a powerful companion option to provide additional mana acceleration.

The deck focuses on utilizing a combination of sacrifice effects and creature recursion to overwhelm opponents with consistent damage. By sacrificing creatures with cards like Cauldron Familiar and Witch's Oven, players can trigger abilities such as Mayhem Devil's ping effect to deal damage to the opponent. The goal is to control the board with removal spells like Fatal Push and Claim the Firstborn while steadily building up a board presence to outvalue the opponent. The companion, Jegantha, the Wellspring, provides additional mana ramp and utility to further enhance the deck's aggressive strategy.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's resources through a combination of hand disruption, removal spells, and powerful creatures. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Duress, while removing threats with Fatal Push and Heartless Act. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Archfiend of the Dross to close out the game. With a mix of disruption and powerful threats, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast the opponent to secure victory.

The deck focuses on sacrificing creatures to gain value and deal direct damage to the opponent, utilizing cards like Cauldron Familiar, Bloodtithe Harvester, Mayhem Devil, and Witch's Oven. It also incorporates removal spells like Fatal Push and Claim the Firstborn to control the board. The inclusion of Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger adds another dimension of disruption to the opponent's hand and graveyard. Jegantha, the Wellspring serves as a companion to provide additional mana fixing. The deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain board control throughout the game.
